summary: First full run for Fisher Family Portal. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (auth member/admin, session cookie, GET/PUT content with admin-only enforcement, contact submit). Frontend: e2e flows verified via Playwright — wrong-password error, member login, session persistence across reload, protected route redirect, logout, all 6 nav cards navigate correctly with back-to-dashboard, admin login shows edit-mode-toggle, edit mode enables Editable inputs, changing an alert topic makes save-changes-btn appear, PUT /api/content persists across reload, add-alert and delete-alert work, contact form submits and shows contact-success, documents filter buttons clickable. No functional bugs found.

minor.issue: CORS uses env FRONTEND_URL fallback to http://localhost:3000. If FRONTEND_URL is not set to the external preview origin, browser requests from the deployed frontend could fail credentialed CORS. In practice tests pass, so it appears configured, but worth confirming FRONTEND_URL is the exact preview origin.

issues: Add Alert / Delete Alert are only accessible in edit mode — expected. No visible issues.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — should migrate to lifespan handlers (non-blocking, but will break on future FastAPI).
GET /api/content requires auth then returns 404 if seed missing — startup seeds on empty DB, so acceptable, but consider ensuring seed also self-heals if doc is deleted.
Cookie is set with samesite='none'; secure=True — correct for cross-site preview, but will break in local http dev; document this.
No brute-force lockout implemented on member-login or admin-login (playbook mentions 5-attempt lockout). Consider rate-limiting.
Contact form does not sanitize/limit message length — could allow very large payload. Add server-side max length in ContactMessage.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded content; PUT test mutates then restores reunion.year and one alert topic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct testids for contact form are contact-name / contact-email / contact-topic (select) / contact-message / contact-phone (not *-input). Editable component uses data-testid=`edit-<path>` (e.g., edit-alerts.0.topic). save-changes-btn only renders when editMode && dirty. edit-mode-toggle is only rendered when authenticated as admin. Use bounding_box() rather than is_visible() when checking cards below the fold, or scroll into view first.
